title: Settings or development: choose the appropriate change
goal: Distinguish a personal list setting from a structural configuration change and justify a minimal solution.
prerequisites: 1c-enterprise.a 3; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.
outcomes: Demonstrate a filter changes visibility while preserving requests.
Separate a technical object name, synonym and item value.
Plan one missing field without unnecessary objects or original-base changes.
sections: Make customers easier to use is not a complete specification. Ask whether the person needs to find an existing item, change a caption or store new text per customer. Those tasks use different mechanisms. Record an action and an observable acceptance result.

Our next task is precise: store a short training note separately from each customer name. It must survive writing and reopening the same item. Use synthetic information only; never put passwords, personal or business data in this field.

A ≥45 filter selects requests, sorting changes order and grouping gathers details. They use existing fields without creating a Клиенты attribute or changing document storage structure. Disable the filter and compare original numbers to prove reversibility.

A setting may be saved per user and variant, but verify its actual scope in the application. Do not claim a personal filter changes all users. A visible column alone does not prove new storage; it might expose an existing field. Inspect metadata first.
Names, synonyms and values serve different roles

In Designer open Справочники → Клиенты → Основные. Имя Клиенты participates in code such as Справочники.Клиенты. Синоним is its readable label. Учебный Север — ремонт is one Enterprise item’s name. Confusing these levels causes unnecessary changes.

A synonym change does not create another catalog; renaming an item does not add a field. A note needs a string attribute. Another application could offer an additional-attributes mechanism, but this small original package does not promise one. Do not search indefinitely or introduce third-party development for this exercise.
A minimal change has boundaries and tests

Choose one УчебнаяЗаметка string attribute in existing Клиенты, synonym Учебная заметка, length 80 and optional. Retain existing names, codes, references and requests. The package’s automatically generated form should expose the field after updating; verify it instead of assuming this for every custom form.

Define acceptance first: the earlier item opens with the same code, its note writes and rereads, another customer initially has an empty note, and request totals/scope remain unchanged. Saving development and updating database configuration are separate actions in the next two lessons. Retain the original and verified .dt as return points.

Store each customer’s note → catalog attribute.

lab.title: Demonstrate the settings boundary and specify one change
lab.environment: Official installed 1C, your continuing copy; no programming.
steps: Open the copy, clear search and your filters and record actual numbers and minutes, including additional work.
Set ДлительностьМинут, Больше или равно, 45; apply and compare visible numbers.
Disable the condition, compare original numbers and minutes and close Enterprise for your copy.
Read Имя and Синоним, compare them with your item’s name in the table and close without edits.
Describe the note need, УчебнаяЗаметка, Строка, length 80, optionality and four preservation checks. Explain why filtering or renaming does not solve it.
expected: A table exists; sequential values are 30/45/30/15.
Only matching requests are visible; values unchanged.
Original documents return; no storage attribute was created.
Technical name, label and item value are explained separately.
One-field decision and acceptance record prepared; structure unchanged.
evidence: Baseline and restored set after filtering.
Mechanism decision and acceptance criteria with synthetic data.
lab.negative: If the attribute already exists, inspect its role and form instead of adding a duplicate.

mistakes: An empty filtered list is interpreted as deleted data.
Disable restrictions and compare original numbers before recreating records.
One item is renamed in an attempt to add a catalog-wide field.
Separate values from structure and choose one attribute.
Every need triggers new development without inspecting existing fields.
Inspect the model and settings, then justify a minimal change.
